profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Hinge Health
profile.summary:
Staff Engineer with 10+ years of experience in full-stack development. Currently focused on technical leadership, driving architectural decisions, and mentoring engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.

Proven track record of leading complex projects from conception to deployment, with deep expertise in system design and architecture. Strong background in the health, wellness, and fitness industry, bringing both technical excellence and domain knowledge to drive product innovation.
